regime_context: The detector shows a narrowing leadership landscape with Gold Miners and Industrial Metals tightly contesting the top rank. Momentum ranks are a focus lens with no predictive edge, the absolute-trend gate has not historically reduced drawdown in this market, and the track record is poor (hit rate 0.41, directional accuracy 0.32). Therefore, any directional leans are highly uncertain and should be treated as experimental conditionals, not forecasts.
emerging_watch: Watch for Industrial Metals (512400.SS) to outperform Gold Miners (using a representative gold miners index) by more than 2% on a rolling 5-day basis, which would confirm a leadership handoff from unscorable Gold Miners to scorable Industrial Metals. This watch is retired if the detector score margin between Gold Miners and Industrial Metals widens back above 0.05 and stays there for three consecutive days.
